title: Disable Village Loot
description: Removes all loot found in chests within villages.
body: # Disable Village Loot Datapack ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.19+-green) Disables all loot from chests in villages. This can be added to your current world and will disable newly generated villages. ## How To Install 1. Download zip file. 2. Navigate to the datapacks folder in your minecraft world: `%appdata%/.minecraft/saves/worldname/datapacks/` 3. Drag downloaded zip file into this folder (you don’t have to unzip it). 4. The datapack will be active next time you load your world. If not, run the /reload command. --- You can view all of my datapacks, mods and modpacks [here](https://silentdoommc.netlify.app/).
